title: Is the AI Gold Rush Still On? A Historical Look at Amazon's AWS Offers a Compellingly Clear Answer.
title_zh: 人工智能淘金热还在继续吗？对亚马逊 AWS 的历史回顾提供了令人信服的清晰答案。
summary: Amazon has been one of the early AI winners.
summary_zh: 亚马逊是早期人工智能的赢家之一。

title: Will There Be a Stock Market Crash Under President Donald Trump? One Forecasting Tool With 155 Years of History in Its Sails Offers an Answer.
title_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下的股市会崩盘吗？一款拥有 155 年历史的预测工具提供了答案。
summary: This measure has an immaculate track record of predicting big moves for stocks.
summary_zh: 这项指标在预测股市大幅波动方面有着完美的记录。

title: AVGO's Google Deal Aids Infrastructure Software Growth: What's Ahead?
title_zh: AVGO 与 Google 的交易有助于基础设施软件的增长：未来是什么？
summary: Broadcom teams up with Google Cloud to launch Cloud Network Insights, offering end-to-end observability for multi-cloud, hybrid and SaaS environments.
summary_zh: Broadcom 与 Google Cloud 合作推出 Cloud Network Insights，为多云、混合和 SaaS 环境提供端到端可观察性。

title: 4 Financial Pros Offer 5 Stocks, 3 ETFs to Play the Software Bust
title_zh: 4 名金融专业人士提供 5 只股票、3 只 ETF 来应对软件泡沫破灭
summary: Software stocks tumbled again after IBM and ServiceNow earnings. But cybersecurity and data stocks may be bargains.
summary_zh: IBM 和 ServiceNow 公布财报后，软件股再次暴跌。但网络安全和数据股票可能很便宜。

title: Firestone Country Club ownership could change as part of $3B deal
title_zh: 作为 30 亿美元交易的一部分，Firestone 乡村俱乐部的所有权可能会发生变化
summary: Private equity firm KSL Capital Partners seeks to buy Invited Clubs — which has Firestone Country Club and Silver Lake County Club in its holdings.
summary_zh: 私募股权公司 KSL Capital Partners 寻求收购 Invited Clubs，该俱乐部旗下拥有凡士通乡村俱乐部 (Firestone Country Club) 和银湖乡村俱乐部 (Silver Lake County Club)。
